Item: Income tax when you cannot work
Notes: Tax in Finland is taken from income. No income = no income tax. Sickness allowance and pensions are taxable, but the tax is low because the income is low. Order a new tax card in MyTax (OmaVero) when income drops so too much tax is not withheld. Not working does not create a tax debt and does not remove your right to health care - that right comes from living in Finland, not from paying tax.

Item: Old tax debt you cannot pay (e.g. back taxes, property tax)
Notes: Apply for a payment arrangement in MyTax: max 2 years, smallest instalment 20, tax is not sent to enforcement while you follow the plan. Late interest 4.5 % in 2026.
Possible if illness has clearly reduced your ability to pay. Illness alone is not enough; the Tax Administration looks at your whole situation. Apply separately.

Item: Private clinic bills you cannot pay
Notes: No fee relief and no social assistance for these. The clinic can stop treatment and send the bill to collection. You can move to public care at any time with a referral.
